title: A.S.I. DIGITAL REBOUND HAMMER
description: Introducing the ASI91 Series Digital Concrete Test Hammers - a cutting-edge, fully automated solution for precise concrete compressive strength assessment. With its integrated calculation, memory, and recording capabilities, obtaining accurate test results has never been quicker or more straightforward. **Key Features:** 1. **Durable Aluminium Body:** Crafted with high-grade aluminium, ensuring longevity and reliability even in demanding conditions. 2. **Audible Feedback:** Experience convenient voice read-outs after each impact, enhancing usability and accessibility. 3. **Seamless Connectivity:** Equipped with low-energy Bluetooth technology and USB ports for both charging and seamless data transmission. 4. **Automated Statistical Analysis:** Enjoy the benefits of automatic statistical processing and readings, streamlining the analysis process. 5. **Wireless Bluetooth Printer Compatibility:** Effortlessly connect to a wireless Bluetooth printer for convenient on-site documentation. 6. **Rechargeable Internal Battery:** Say goodbye to constant battery replacements. The built-in rechargeable battery ensures sustained, hassle-free operation. Elevate your concrete testing experience with the ASI91 Series - a blend of precision, efficiency, and technological innovation. Trust in a tool designed to meet the demands of professionals in the field.
